observations: The page number «42» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: «auch» continues the sentence that ends p. 41 (JP2 0073, L38) with a semicolon.

L08-L12: the computation of the year, set as a small table: the ditto marks „ stand under «In» and under «Tagen»; the last row, «also in 365d 6h 13m = 360° 0′ 0″», stands below a rule across the table; «·», the raised dot of multiplication. L23-L27 and L29-L33: the two examples, set as tables: the ditto marks „ under «Zunahme in»; the sums below a short rule under the figures; L23 and L29 «1. Sonne :», «2. Mond :» in italics with their numbers; L33 has «Summa : =», L27 «Summa =». Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the words room and are not printed. L13-L14: «365d 6h 13m», «365d 6h 12,6m», the letters raised.

L08-L12, L23-L34. Checked: 12 × 29° 34′ 5″ = 354° 49′; the four values add up to 360° 0′ 0″; 38° 35′ 45″ + 49° 2′ 50″ + 29° 34′ 5″ + 13° 47′ 54″ = 131° 0′ 34″, and 40° 56′ 38″ + 53° 24′ 16″ + 35° 17′ 26″ + 184° 28′ 8″ = 314° 6′ 28″. The month of the examples is Muḥarram, 30 days, and the 14 days run from noon of 1 Ṣafar to noon of 15 Ṣafar; the 29 years 511-539 have eleven leap years, 10277 days; the 510 years are seventeen cycles of 10631 days, 180727 days.

L08-L14. Checked: the values for 360 days, 5 days, 6 hours and 13 minutes are rounded to the second and the first is twelve times the rounded value for thirty days, so that they fix the length of the year only to within a few minutes. The long periods of the tables fix it more closely, and they fit the year of Brahmagupta's Brahmasphuṭasiddhānta, 1 577 916 450 000 days in 4 320 000 000 years, 365.2584375 days or 365d 6h 12m 9s: with it 10277 days give 49° 2′ 50″, the value of L24, and 180727 days added to the radix 113° 25′ 48″ (p. 41, JP2 0073, L36) give 38° 35′ 47″, against 38° 35′ 45″ in L23; 30 days give 29° 34′ 5″ and 14 days 13° 47′ 54″, as in L25-L26. The year of 365d 6h 13m (L13) gives 49° 1′ 48″ and 38° 17′ 45″, the Sūrya-Siddhānta's year of 1 577 917 828 days in 4 320 000 years 49° 2′ 18″ and 38° 26′ 27″. For the moon, Brahmagupta's 57 753 300 000 revolutions in the same days give 53° 24′ 17″ for the 29 years (L30: 53° 24′ 16″), 35° 17′ 26″ for 30 days and 184° 28′ 8″ for 14 days, as in L31-L32; the Sūrya-Siddhānta's 57 753 336 revolutions give 53° 22′ 15″ for the 29 years.
